subject: Customize output of excel export of DT button extension

messages.author: 7c37715e017b5370
messages.subject: Customize output of excel export of DT button extension
parts:
Hi All,
I am using DT with button extension in project.
I set column as html link in dataframe:

barcodes$PrimaryBarcode <- paste0("<a href='","https://mysite.com/?brc=",
                                          barcodes$PrimaryBarcode,"' target='_blank'>",barcodes4$PrimaryBarcode,"\t","</a>") ,

where PrimaryBarcode is chr  like 20000208920402700000629190006440881

All works fine in browser. 
When I export to excel this dataset I see that this column has number format and looks like:

2.000002789274893E+33

How can I avoid changing of format during export?
I read docs about customization of Excel file that Buttons creates.
All examples in JS. May be someone has R shiny working example?
Main goal is to receive the same clickable link in Excel file as in browser. 
 
Thank you!

messages.subject: Re: Customize output of excel export of DT button extension
parts:
Update:
I solved this problem by using downloadButton instead of DT button extension.
I receive all dataset without filters, which applied in DT. This is fine in my case.
To avoid converting to number format I changed Barcode from 20000208920402700000629190006440881 to  ="20000208920402700000629190006440881".

Code of handler:
output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() {
      paste("Result_", gsub(":", "_", Sys.time()), ".csv",sep="")
    },
    content = function(file) {
      # datasetInput returns list of data frames. First column in all data frames is Barcode, for which we want to receive text format in excel. 
      res<-datasetInput()
      res<-lapply(res, function(x){ x[,1]<-gsub("(\\d+)","=\"\\1\"",x[,1]); return(x)})
      resToWrite<-bind_rows(res)
      write.csv(resToWrite, file)
      
    }
  )
